SELECT USERID , CATEGORYID , USAGENM , CATEGORYNM , CATEGORYDETAILNM , CLASSIFICATION FROM ACC_CATEGORY WHERE USERID = #{USERID}
AND USAGENM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND CATEGORYNM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND CATEGORYDETAILNM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
ORDER BY REGDATE DESC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY BANKNM, ACCOUNTNUM) AS ROWNUM , USERID , ACCOUNTID , BANKNM , ACCOUNTNUM , INITMONEY FROM ACC_ACCOUNT WHERE USERID = #{USERID}
AND BANKNM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND ACCOUNTNUM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
ORDER BY BANKNM, ACCOUNTNUM
